title: Opus 4.7 Context Window Fix — 1M Correctly Applied (v2.1.117)
description: In v2.1.117, a bug was fixed where Opus 4.7 sessions were computing context usage against 200K tokens instead of the model's native 1M context window. This caused `/context` to show inflated percentages and triggered autocompaction far too early on Opus 4.7. With the fix, Opus 4.7 sessions correctly use the 1M context limit, preventing premature compaction in long iterative-improve and heartbeat sessions. No configuration change needed — automatic with v2.1.117.
redundancy_check: IMPROVEMENT — existing registry entry for Opus 4.7 (v2.1.111) documents the model but does not mention this context calculation bug. Registry update needed to note the fix.
